name: Merge Pets! 🐾
desc:
🐾 Merge animals to discover rarer ones! 🐾

Welcome to Merge PETS! In this game, you can:

Combine animals to create unique and adorable creatures! 🐣
Customize with fun trails, themes, and decorations! 🎨
Hatch, trade, and grow your pet collection! 🐰
Earn rare loot to unlock upgrades and special rewards!
Climb the leaderboards and show off your best animals! 🏆

Start merging now and build the ultimate animal collection!
